type Props = { items: string[]; show: boolean; label: string };

// Component: JSX is parsed with the tsx grammar. Decision points: the ternary
// and the && inside the JSX expressions, the if; the arrow callback in map is
// anonymous and counts toward Component.
export function Component(props: Props) {
  if (!props.show) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <ul>
      {props.items.map((item) => (item ? <li>{item}</li> : null))}
      {props.label && <span>{props.label}</span>}
    </ul>
  );
}

const Row = ({ label }: { label: string }) => <b>{label ? label : ''}</b>;
